cards.title: RoPE 2D rotation (fixed geometry)
cards.prompt:
Square infographic for a Chinese AI education article about RoPE (Rotary Position Embedding).

MAIN VISUAL: A 2D coordinate plane, x-axis pointing right, y-axis pointing up. From the SAME single origin point, draw three arrows of identical length, fanning out counterclockwise:

- Arrow 1 lies flat along the positive x-axis (angle 0°). Label: "位置 0：不旋转".
- Arrow 2 rotated 60° counterclockwise, pointing to the UPPER RIGHT (well to the right of the y-axis). Label: "q₁ = (0.5, 0.866)，位置 1：旋转 60°".
- Arrow 3 rotated 120° counterclockwise, pointing to the UPPER LEFT (to the LEFT of the y-axis, its x component is negative). Label: "q₂ = (−0.5, 0.866)，位置 2：旋转 120°".

Draw a small dashed arc between the x-axis and arrow q₁, labeled "60°". Draw a second dashed arc between arrow q₁ and arrow q₂, also labeled "60°" — showing that each step of position rotates by the same angle.

CRITICAL GEOMETRY (must be exact): all three arrows start from the same origin; q₁ leans RIGHT of the y-axis; q₂ leans LEFT of the y-axis (pointing upper-left). Both arcs read "60°". Do NOT draw arrows starting from different points on the x-axis.

VISIBLE TEXT: Chinese labels only — "位置 0：不旋转", "位置 1：旋转 60°", "位置 2：旋转 120°", vector labels "q₁ = (0.5, 0.866)" and "q₂ = (−0.5, 0.866)", axis labels "x 轴" and "y 轴", the two arc labels "60°". A small formula block near the bottom: "相对旋转 = (j−i)θ". No English text, no title, no model names, no dates.

STYLE: Clean editorial science infographic, flat-vector style, light warm background, dark ink lines for axes and arrows, muted blue for the rotation arcs and angle labels. Simple, precise, friendly. No realistic people, no logos, no gradients, no dense content.

All visible text must be Chinese.

cards.title: rope_theta comparison (new models)
cards.prompt:
Square infographic for a Chinese AI education article comparing rope_theta values across three Chinese LLMs (all released 2026).

MAIN VISUAL: Three columns, one per model, each with a circular dial/knob whose pointer shows rotation speed. Rotation speed DECREASES from left to right.

Left column (model name "DeepSeek-V4 Pro"): Fast-spinning dial with many circular motion swoosh lines around it, pointer at a large angle. Label below the dial: "rope_theta = 10,000". Small annotation: "YaRN 64K → 1M". Below that, a WIDE horizontal bar representing context range, labeled "上下文范围".

Center column (model name "Qwen3-235B"): Slow dial, pointer at a small angle, only a few motion lines. Label below: "rope_theta = 1,000,000". Small annotation: "原生 32K + 可选 YaRN". Below that, a NARROW thin horizontal bar, labeled "上下文范围".

Right column (model name "GLM-5.2"): Slowest dial, pointer barely moved, almost no motion lines. Label below: "rope_theta = 8,000,000". Small annotation: "原生 1M". Below that, a WIDE horizontal bar, labeled "上下文范围".

The visual metaphor: faster rotation = sharper nearby resolution but far range needs interpolation; slower rotation = natively covers longer range but nearby gets blurry.

VISIBLE TEXT: Chinese labels only — a small coral header badge "旋转速度" above the three columns; model names "DeepSeek-V4 Pro", "Qwen3-235B", "GLM-5.2"; the three rope_theta values exactly as "rope_theta = 10,000", "rope_theta = 1,000,000", "rope_theta = 8,000,000"; the three annotations exactly as "YaRN 64K → 1M", "原生 32K + 可选 YaRN", "原生 1M"; a bottom legend line: "旋转快：近处分得清，远距靠插值｜旋转慢：原生看得远，近处易模糊". No other English text, no title, no dates.

STYLE: Clean editorial science infographic, flat-vector style, light warm background, dark ink lines, muted blue and coral accents. Three-column layout with generous whitespace between columns. Simple, precise, friendly. No realistic people, no logos, no gradients, no dense content.

All visible text must be Chinese and the three values must exactly match: 10,000 / 1,000,000 / 8,000,000.
